intro: Across technology, government, healthcare, telecommunications, and critical infrastructure, 37 zero-day articles published between 2026-04-12 and 2026-09-16 document a severe period. The severity mix comprises 19 high, 17 critical, and one medium entry. APT29, Chaotic Eclipse, and Claude Mythos feature among the top threat actors. Prominent CVEs include CVE-2026-22679 at CVSS 9.8, CVE-2026-34621 at CVSS 8.6, and CVE-2026-3502, CVE-2026-81963, and CVE-2026-85880, each at CVSS 7.8. Impact spans Global, Asia, Brazil, China, and Europe.
